rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-8, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-4 PEAK base (SSIM 0.9732, PSNR 38.21 dB; img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005 tight, n_iter=300). KNOB: projection-domain BF range sigma proj_sr 0.02 -> 0.0005 (tight/edge-preserving in the sinogram). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-4 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300 REVERTED from iter-7's 600 ceiling-probe, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, seed=42; proj_sx/proj_sy left at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (ALL THREE proj sigmas tuned at once off the LOOSE iter-1 base proj_sx=0.01/proj_sy=0.3/proj_sr=0.0005) 0.9680/37.90 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.9723/38.19; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732/38.21 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729 SAT; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT; iter-7 (n_iter 300->600) 0.9732 FLAT -- BF converges in 300 steps (representational ceiling, NOT under-convergence). FAILURE MODE at 0.9732: ALL FOUR image-domain axes (depth img_n_bf, range img_sr, kernel img_kernel, optimization n_iter) are EXHAUSTED; PSNR pinned ~1.5 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline, hr=0. The PROJECTION domain is the one untested axis at the PEAK base -- iter-2's proj attempt swapped proj_sx AND proj_sy AND proj_sr SIMULTANEOUSLY off the loose-img_sr/img_n_bf=1 iter-1 base (confound: cannot tell which proj sigma hurt, and the base was 0.0012 SSIM below the peak). WHY proj_sr NOW (isolated, breast=tight direction per mayo_campaign_state.md): the campaign-state N2I knob insight records 128-view substrates respond to the IMAGE-domain img_sr (now exhausted) and that breast wants TIGHT range sigmas (img_sr->0.0005 worked, iter-3); the symmetric untested lever is the sinogram-domain range sigma proj_sr. At the loose default 0.02 (>> the breast sinogram value range) the projection BF degenerates toward an angular/radial Gaussian that smears sparse-view samples BEFORE FBP; tightening proj_sr to 0.0005 (<< data range) makes it edge-preserving on the air/breast attenuation boundary in the sinogram, denoising the 128-view streak source edge-preservingly instead of blurring it. This isolates proj_sr ONLY (proj_sx/proj_sy stay at defaults, unlike the confounded iter-2). HYPOTHESIS: tight proj_sr=0.0005 cleans the sinogram edge-preservingly before FBP, lifting PSNR toward the 39.68 dB baseline and SSIM above the 0.9732 peak. If FLAT (SSIM within +-0.0005 of iter-4), the projection-range axis is ALSO exhausted and the ~0.973 12-param structural ceiling is CONFIRMED across BOTH domains -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP (mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). WALL: step budget identical to iter-4 (n_iter back to 300; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-4 ran 448 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
